integrity: The proof gives a bijection between rank-one idempotents and projective antiflags, converts orthogonality to cross-incidence, and counts neighbors and common neighbors by elementary projective-space formulas. A standalone checker reconstructs the graphs in five finite cases and verifies all stated local and global counts.
scientific_limitations: The theorem concerns only the primitive-idempotent induced subgraph of the indecomposability graph.
The matrix ring is \(M_n(\mathbb F_q)\) with \(n\ge3\) and \(q\) a prime power.
Higher-rank idempotents in the full indecomposability graph are not classified.
The finite checker samples prime fields; arbitrary prime powers are covered by the projective proof.
title: Edge-regular primitive-idempotent graphs of finite full matrix rings
